name: Josiah
bio: Josiah was named more than three centuries before his birth, in a prophecy spoken by an unnamed man of God from Judah who confronted Jeroboam at the idolatrous altar in Bethel: "A son named Josiah will be born to the house of David. On you he will sacrifice the priests of the high places who now make offerings here, and human bones will be burned on you" (1 Kings 13:1-2). This remarkably specific, long-range prophecy was fulfilled centuries later when King Josiah of Judah, in the course of his sweeping religious reforms, did exactly this — a story told in detail many chapters ahead.
